cases.question: How many days of notice do I need to give for earned leave?
cases.ground_truth: Earned Leave (EL) must be applied for at least 7 calendar days before the first day of leave.
cases.reply: At least 7 calendar days before the first day. (Leave Policy)
contexts:
Leave Policy › 4. Notice expected
| Leave | Notice |
|---|---|
| Earned Leave (EL) | At least 7 calendar days before the first day |
| Casual Leave (CL) | At least 1 working day before, wherever possible |
| Sick Leave (SL) | Inform the manager on the first day of absence; apply in the app on return |

Sick leave of **three or more consecutive days** requires a medical certificate to be uploaded on the
**Documents** page.

cases.question: How many casual leaves does an employee get in a year?
cases.ground_truth: Every confirmed employee gets 12 casual leave (CL) days per calendar year.
cases.reply: 12 days of casual leave per year. [Leave Policy]
contexts:
Leave Policy › 1. Leave types and yearly entitlement
Every confirmed employee receives the following leave each calendar year (1 January to 31 December):

| Code | Leave type | Days per year | Typical use |
|---|---|---|---|
| CL | Casual Leave | 12 | Short personal matters, family events, errands |
| SL | Sick Leave | 12 | Illness, medical appointments, recovery |
| EL | Earned Leave | 15 | Planned holidays and longer breaks |
| LWP | Leave Without Pay | No limit | Used when paid leave is exhausted; salary is deducted pro rata |

Employees who join mid-year receive the full entitlement for that year. The company does not currently
pro-rate entitlement by joining date.

Leave Policy › 5. Balances, carry-forward and encashment
- Balances shown in the app count both approved and pending requests, so a pending request already holds the days.
- Unused CL and SL **lapse** on 31 December.
- Unused EL does not currently carry forward in the system. HR reviews exceptions case by case.
- Leave encashment is not offered at present.

Leave Policy › 4. Notice expected
| Leave | Notice |
|---|---|
| Earned Leave (EL) | At least 7 calendar days before the first day |
| Casual Leave (CL) | At least 1 working day before, wherever possible |
| Sick Leave (SL) | Inform the manager on the first day of absence; apply in the app on return |

Sick leave of **three or more consecutive days** requires a medical certificate to be uploaded on the
**Documents** page.

cases.question: How much home broadband can I claim each month?
cases.ground_truth: Home broadband is reimbursable up to Rs 1,200 per month for employees working remotely.
cases.reply: ₹1,200 per month. (Expense and Reimbursement Policy)
contexts:
Remote Work and IT Security Policy › 3. Equipment
The company provides a laptop and, on request, a monitor and headset. Home broadband is reimbursable up to
₹1,200 per month; see the Expense and Reimbursement Policy. Report loss, theft or damage to IT the same day.

Expense and Reimbursement Policy › 1. What can be claimed
| Category | Covers | Guideline limit |
|---|---|---|
| Travel | Cabs, trains, flights and hotels for company work | Economy fare; hotels up to ₹6,000 per night |
| Meals | Client meals and team meals during work | ₹1,000 per person per meal |
| Internet | Home broadband for employees working remotely | ₹1,200 per month |
| Training | Courses, certifications and conference fees | ₹15,000 per year, manager approval first |
| Other | Office supplies and anything not listed above | ₹3,000 per claim |

Amounts above these guidelines need written approval from the manager **before** the spend, attached to the claim.

cases.question: How long do I have to submit an expense claim after I spend the money?
cases.ground_truth: Expense claims must be submitted within 30 days of the spend; older claims need an explanation and HR approval.
cases.reply: Within 30 days of the spend. Older claims need an explanation and HR approval. (Expense and Reimbursement Policy)
contexts:
Expense and Reimbursement Policy › 3. How to claim
1. Open the **Expenses** page in the DISHA HR app and press New claim.
2. Enter the date of spend, category, amount in rupees and a short description.
3. Attach the receipt. Files up to 7 MB are accepted. Claims above ₹500 without a receipt are rejected.
4. Submit. The claim goes to the employee's reporting manager; employees reporting to an admin are approved by Finance.

Claims must be submitted within **30 days** of the spend. Older claims need an explanation and HR approval.

cases.question: How is HRA calculated on my payslip?
cases.ground_truth: HRA is 40 percent of basic salary.
cases.reply: - HRA is 40% of your Basic salary. (Payroll and Payslips Policy)
contexts:
Payroll and Payslips Policy › 2. What makes up the salary
Each payslip shows these components:

| Component | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Basic | The base salary component |
| HRA | House Rent Allowance, 40% of basic |
| Allowances | Other allowances; may include an annual performance bonus in March |
| **Gross** | Basic + HRA + Allowances |
| Deductions | Provident Fund at 12% of basic, plus professional tax |
| **Net pay** | Gross minus deductions, the amount credited to the bank |

cases.question: How many days a week do I have to come to the office?
cases.ground_truth: The default is three days in the office - Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday - with up to two days remote.
cases.reply: - Three days a week: Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday. [Remote Work and IT Security Policy]
contexts:
Remote Work and IT Security Policy › 1. Hybrid working
- The default is **three days in the office** (Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday) and up to two days remote.
- Teams may agree different days with their manager, as long as the team has enough overlap.
- Fully remote arrangements need HR approval and are reviewed every six months.
- Remote days still require check-in and check-out in the DISHA HR app, and being reachable during working hours.

cases.question: A client wants to give me a gift. When do I have to declare it?
cases.ground_truth: Gifts or hospitality worth more than Rs 2,500 must be declined or declared to HR. Bribes and kickbacks are never allowed.
cases.reply: - If the gift is worth more than ₹2,500, you must decline it or declare it to HR. (Code of Conduct)
contexts:
Code of Conduct › 5. Gifts and anti-bribery
Do not offer or accept bribes or kickbacks. Gifts or hospitality worth more than ₹2,500 must be declined or
declared to HR. Never offer anything of value to a government official.

Expense and Reimbursement Policy › 2. What cannot be claimed
Personal travel, alcohol, fines and traffic penalties, personal subscriptions and entertainment, gifts to
clients without prior approval, and any expense already paid directly by the company.

cases.question: How many casual leaves do I have left this year?

cases.reply: You have 9 casual leaves left this year.

cases.question: How many days did I work in August 2026?
cases.truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS v FROM attendance WHERE user_id = (SELECT id FROM users WHERE email = 'sneha.iyer@company.com') AND date >= '2026-08-01' AND date < '2026-09-01'
cases.reply: You worked 19 days in August 2026.
cases.sql: SELECT employee, COUNT(*) AS worked_days FROM attendance WHERE user_id = (SELECT id FROM me) AND strftime('%Y-%m', date) = '2026-08' GROUP BY employee LIMIT 200

cases.question: What was my net pay in July 2026?

cases.reply: Your net pay in July 2026 was ₹54,140.
